name: Kimi to Sugosu Hibi -Kisaragi Ayaka-
original_name: 君と過ごす日々-如月綾香-
source:
In the dog days of hot summer, you go on a beach date with your girlfriend.
You rub sun oil on each other, get naughty behind some rocks, and make passionate love in the hotel at night.

Enjoy your special time with your slightly S older girlfriend.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ264845.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
酷暑盛夏的三伏天里，你与女友一同前往海滩约会。
两人互相涂抹防晒油，躲在礁石后面偷偷亲热，入夜后又在酒店房间里尽情缠绵。

尽情享受与这位略带S属性的年上女友共度的甜蜜时光吧。
